premises.text: America has massive car overpopulation: hundreds of millions of cars sit parked most of the day
premises.evidence_span: over 250 million cars in America that sit parked 22 hours each day

premises.text: GetAround is a peer-to-peer car-sharing marketplace where nearby owners set price/availability and renters book via an iPhone app with ratings and reviews
premises.evidence_span: a marketplace for peer-to-peer car sharing, the Airbnb for cars

premises.text: The Getaround Car Kit enables smartphone keyless unlock/locate with Wi-Fi and GPS, installable in minutes without fleet-management complexity
premises.evidence_span: device that combines a keyless remote with Wi-Fi and GPS

premises.text: Insurance is included in each rental via a carrier deal that enables national expansion
premises.evidence_span: Getaround provides insurance as part of each rental

premises.text: Peer-to-peer model works beyond dense urban Zipcar-style fleets; platform takes commission while owners earn and renters avoid buying
premises.evidence_span: The peer-to-peer model is not limited to dense urban areas like Zipcar

value.text: Rent a nearby car instantly instead of buying; owners earn by sharing—redefining car ownership
value.evidence_span: Instead of buying a car, you can rent one instantly from someone nearby

secondary_value.text: Large-scale sharing would cut cars on the road and CO2 emissions
secondary_value.evidence_span: CO2 emissions would drop by a whopping 48 billion pounds per year

causal_links.evidence_span: solving a problem we call car overpopulation
With it, you can unlock the car and locate the car, all from your iPhone
How does insurance work? Getaround provides insurance as part of each rental

notes: Owner pricing, SF/Bay listings, request/confirm, ratings folded into marketplace; Car Kit kept as distinct hardware module that enables hassle-free access (§4.1.5 split). 40% commission folded into marketplace commercial facet with P5. Million-car/CO2 vision is secondary_value not a premise (§4.1.4). Free car-kit giveaway and no membership fees are promo/pricing detail on availability. Carrier name in evidence avoided in premise text where possible—span uses general insurance claim.
